import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
import os

# Read input
input_path = "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify indicator columns: numeric columns excluding city_id, city_name, year
id_cols = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"]
indicator_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in id_cols]

# Keep raw values (with missing) for profile computation
raw_indicators = df[indicator_cols].copy()

# Median imputation
imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy="median")
imputed = imputer.fit_transform(raw_indicators)
imputed_df = pd.DataFrame(imputed, columns=indicator_cols)

# Standard scaling
scaler = StandardScaler()
scaled = scaler.fit_transform(imputed_df)

# KMeans clustering
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)
cluster_labels = kmeans.fit_predict(scaled)

# Write t13_city_clusters.csv
out_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "city_id": df["city_id"],
    "city_name": df["city_name"],
    "year": df["year"],
    "cluster_id": cluster_labels
})
out_df.to_csv("outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv", index=False)

# Write t13_cluster_profiles.csv
# For each cluster, compute mean of raw indicator values over non-missing values
profiles_rows = []
for cid in sorted(set(cluster_labels)):
    mask = cluster_labels == cid
    row = {"cluster_id": cid}
    for col in indicator_cols:
        vals = raw_indicators.loc[mask, col]
        # mean over non-missing values
        row[col] = vals.mean()  # pandas .mean() skips NaN by default
    profiles_rows.append(row)

profiles_df = pd.DataFrame(profiles_rows)
profiles_df.to_csv("outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv", index=False)
</solution_file>

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
import os

# Read input
input_path = "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify indicator columns: numeric columns excluding city_id, city_name, year
id_cols = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"]
indicator_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in id_cols]

# Keep raw values (with missing) for profile computation
raw_indicators = df[indicator_cols].copy()

# Median imputation
imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy="median")
imputed = imputer.fit_transform(raw_indicators)
imputed_df = pd.DataFrame(imputed, columns=indicator_cols)

# Standard scaling
scaler = StandardScaler()
scaled = scaler.fit_transform(imputed_df)

# KMeans clustering
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)
cluster_labels = kmeans.fit_predict(scaled)

# Write t13_city_clusters.csv
out_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "city_id": df["city_id"],
    "city_name": df["city_name"],
    "year": df["year"],
    "cluster_id": cluster_labels
})
out_df.to_csv("outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv", index=False)

# Write t13_cluster_profiles.csv
# For each cluster, compute mean of raw indicator values over non-missing values
profiles_rows = []
for cid in sorted(set(cluster_labels)):
    mask = cluster_labels == cid
    row = {"cluster_id": cid}
    for col in indicator_cols:
        vals = raw_indicators.loc[mask, col]
        # mean over non-missing values
        row[col] = vals.mean()  # pandas .mean() skips NaN by default
    profiles_rows.append(row)

profiles_df = pd.DataFrame(profiles_rows)
profiles_df.to_csv("outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv", index=False)
